boundary_evidence: contiguous linker run: 0x0206879c..0x0206a318, 23 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt (each entry's end is the next entry's start, all marked `complete`).

SOURCE ORDER: mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order. Read from the top down, the run is the function order of the BW2 decomp's reconstruction of the Nitro SDK's mb_wm_base.c (changeScanChannel, MBi_IsSendEnabled, ..., MBi_GetAttribute, MBi_IsStarted, MBi_CheckWmErrcode) with the newer SDK's MBi_OnInitializeDone, MBi_EndCommon, MBi_OnReset and MB_DisconnectChild absent; only MBi_SetMaxScanTime and func_0206881c sit out of place, just above MBi_IsStarted.

DATA: the WmWork (data_020a9db4; the BW2 reconstruction's sWmWork, ntrtwl's p_mbi_param), the scan parameter (data_020a9dc0, sScanParam) and the DMA channel (data_020a9db0, sDmaNo) are that file's statics and are written only by functions in this run.

DATA: mbc (0x020a9db8, mb_parent's pPwork, src/engine/mb/MB_Parent.c) sits among those statics in .bss (sDmaNo 0x020a9db0, sWmWork 0x020a9db4, mbc 0x020a9db8, sScanParam 0x020a9dc0), and func_02068e4c (the SDK's MB_Init) carves it out of the caller's buffer. Unlike them it is not file-static in this build: MB_Parent.cpp clears it and MBi_SetRecvBufferFromChild, func_02065de4, MBi_get_blockinfo, func_02067604 and func_02067928 read it, so it has external linkage. NitroSDK's mb_wm_base.c defines it the same way, as the non-static `MB_CommCommonWork *mbc` that mb_private.h externs (`#define pPwork ((MB_CommPWork *)mbc)`).
BOTTOM EDGE: MBi_MakeGameInfo (0x02068680) is the highest-addressed function of the SDK's mb_gameinfo.c (arm9/MB_GameInfo), a different file.
TOP EDGE: CTRDGi_SendtoPxi (0x0206a318) opens the cartridge library's ctrdg_common.c (arm9/CTRDG_Common).
notes: Seven members carry the SDK name on a statement-for-statement match with the reconstruction or the HeartGold fork's mb_comm_params.c; twelve more are an older SDK's version of a named function and take that name (an SDK function keeps its name across versions), each with a comment saying what differs; three getters with no counterpart keep address names.

The SDK built this file as C. Three things keep the C++ compile byte-identical: `#pragma always_inline on` for the whole file, because the GameInfo struct copy is an implicit operator= that is called out of line otherwise, and mwccarm generates code only after reading the whole file, so a push/pop-scoped pragma does not reach it; the WM API declared with pointer callbacks, because passing `(int)func` schedules differently from passing a function's address; and `(u16)(cond ? 1 : 0)` where the C source widened a comparison, because a C++ comparison is a bool.
